info.name: Tayara - Agent (Manage dashboard)
info.description:
Travel-agent API collection. Authenticated calls use the **A-token** header returned by `/api/v1/agent/login`.

Money is in **minor units** (AED fils). Percentages are **basis points** (10000 = 100%). Package child items (hotels/activities/addons) are sent as arrays inside the package body.

The `Files & Uploads` folder documents the `utils/upload` OSS convention for images/docs.

body.raw:
{
  "companyName": "Desert Safari Dubai",
  "responsibleName": "Khalid Al Mansouri",
  "businessEmail": "hello@desertsafari.ae",
  "password": "123456",
  "phoneCountryCode": "+971",
  "phone": "0551010101",
  "country": "UAE",
  "companyAddress": "Al Quoz, Dubai",
  "licenseNumber": "DED-1001",
  "planId": 2
}

item.name: Create Package
item.description: discountPercent must be >= 300 bps (3%). destinationCountryId 1=AE, 2=TR, 7=TH. Child arrays are optional. Tour-detail fields (statusTour, timeDisplay, destination, originalPrice, promoTag) are optional.

item.name: Update Package
item.description: Set `id` to an existing package. Child arrays replace all existing children. Tour-detail fields are optional.

item.name: Review Booking
item.description: Moves a requested booking to agent_reviewing.

item.name: Submit Offer
item.description: finalPrice is minor units. An active offer drives the booking to price_confirmed.

item.name: Upload Booking Document
item.description: JSON body (NOT multipart). docRole: agent_confirmation | issued_ticket | kyc_file. fileUrl is the OSS URL from the Files & Uploads folder. The agent_confirmation file is required for payout eligibility.

item.name: Upload a file (multipart -> utils/upload OSS)
item.description:
Binary images/PDFs are pushed to object storage via `utils/upload.NewOss().UploadFile(file)`, which reads the multipart `file` field and returns `(url, key, err)`.

Body is **multipart/form-data** with a `file` field (the actual binary). The returned URL goes into JSON `fileUrl` / `coverImageURL` / `galleryImages` fields. For this demo the platform has no standalone file route, so point this at your file-service endpoint.
